basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to own a high-floor view residence at The Arden, complete with an expansive outdoor terrace, perfect for alfresco living and dining. This remarkable home features a seamless indoor-outdoor connection, with the living room opening effortlessly onto the deck, where breathtaking southwest views of the city skyline and Twin Peaks await.    The chef's kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, boasting integrated cabinetry, premium Thermador appliances, Grohe fixtures, and a spacious eat-in 13-foot long island. Designed for effortless entertaining, it flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas.    Residence #1411 also offers a thoughtful split floor plan, ensuring privacy with bedrooms positioned on opposite sides of the home. Deeded parking and storage complete this home.    The Arden is best known for its luxury amenities, with 24/7 doorman, pool, fitness center, club room, BBQ area. There is a new second gym which has just opened in the building. Across the street is a pet & children's park. Just around the block, construction is starting for a elementary school, which will have Pre-K through 5th grade.
